user.title: Notification Lights
user.description: Optionally pick an entity that means quiet hours (e.g. a bedtime helper). Add lights and notifications afterwards with the Add buttons on the integration page.

abort.already_configured: Notification Lights is already set up.
abort.aqara_missing: Aqara Advanced Lighting is not set up. Install it through HACS (absent42/Aqara-Advanced-Lighting), add the integration, then try again.

init.title: Quiet hours
init.description: While this entity is on, notifications without Show during quiet hours are hidden on lights marked quiet. Leave empty for no quiet hours.

dismiss_all.name: Dismiss all
dismiss_all.description: Dismiss every active notification until its source next starts.

print_sheet.name: Print sheet
print_sheet.description: Return the printable guide (HTML and a link valid for 10 minutes) and fire the notification_lights_print_sheet event with the link, so an automation can send it to a printer.

user.title: Add notification light
user.description: Pick the _rgb entity of an Aqara ceiling light, not its central room light.

light_details.title: {light}
light_details.description: Rooms and floor are prefilled from the light's device. Leave both empty for a house-only light. List several rooms for an open-plan space.

data_description.offset: Rotates the picture so a footprint starts at the same physical place on every light.

error.not_rgb: Pick the _rgb entity (the outer ring), not the central room light.
error.offset_too_large: Offset must be less than the number of segments.

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: How it looks, where it shows and what raises it. A notification follows its source exactly. Lower priority numbers paint on top.

data_description.delay: Seconds the source must stay active before the notification shows.
data_description.source_entities: Active while any of these is in the active state. Leave empty if you use a template.
data_description.source_template: Active while it renders true. Leave the entities empty if you use this.

error.priority_taken: Another notification already uses this priority.
error.source_required: Pick source entities or write a template.
error.one_source: Use either entities or a template, not both.
